scope: Source profiles, clean native build, three low-level guest boots and three interactive profile sessions; not a new prebuilt release.

checks.dgles: unchanged native build and smoke from networking validation

storage.scope: system/home file persistence through two clean boots and snapshot isolation; not application data or power-loss acceptance

checks.offline_regression: network device is absent with -nic none; strict no-unexpected-stderr gate passed
checks.ctrl_c_exit: guest sync, QEMU exit 0 and clean profile state
checks.cocoa_window_quit: native close and confirmation, deferred guest sync, QEMU exit 0 and clean profile state in two sessions
checks.original_notes: Qemu entered with native mouse clicks on the original keyboard, saved, then visibly present after window quit and full restart

not_tested: new prebuilt packaging/relocation or its profile CLI end to end
physical input in another macOS version or on a second Mac
power-loss durability, automated rollback, arbitrary CPU/RAM save-state
all applications, early-close races and forced-exit recovery of unsaved application content
